description: Gharibwal Cement Limited was incorporated on 29 December 1960 and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its plant at Ismailwal, 30 km along the Pind Dadan Khan–Jhelum road in Tehsil Choa Saidan Shah, District Chakwal, has an installed clinker capacity of 7,500 tonnes per day, fed by company-owned limestone and shale quarries, and a second line of up to 10,000 tonnes per day is under development. The company runs 38.5 MW of in-house generation, a 20 MW waste-heat recovery plant and a 24.5 MW solar plant, and sells cement under the Paidar brand.
headOffice: Pace Tower, 1st Floor, 27 H-Block, College Road, Gulberg-II, Lahore, Pakistan
